1  UPON hearing the counsel the Court made the following  O R D E R 1.

The instant petition has been filed by the petitioner challenging the order dated 13.08.2021,
passed by the Gauhati High Date: 2025.05.09 19:00:13 IST

Reason:
Court, releasing respondent No.2 on bail in a case under Sections 376, 328, 307 and 120-B of IPC.
2.
The record reveals that notice in the petition was issued way back on 08.10.2021.

Unfortunately,
the matter was not listed thereafter.
We are informed that during the pendency of this petition for the last more than four years, the trial has reached at an advanced stage inasmuch as out of 28, 23 witnesses have already been examined.
No instance of misuse of concession of bail by respondent No.2 has been brought on record.

3. That being so, we deem it appropriate to dispose of this petition without interfering with the impugned order, passed by the High Court, however, with a direction to the Trial Court to conclude the trial, in all circumstances, within a period of six months.
Ordered accordingly.
4. Respondent No.2 and his counsel shall extend full cooperation to the Trial Court.
The prosecution will also ensure that the remaining witnesses remain present before the Trial Court on time for their deposition.
5. We, however, do not approve the observations made by the High Court while granting bail to respondent No.2 herein.
Those observations shall have no bearing on the merits of the pending trial.

(SATISH KUMAR YADAV) (PREETHI T.C.)
